metadata.methods_description: EEG data were acquired using a Biosemi ActiveTwo system with 64 electrodes positioned according to the International 10-20 System, sampled at 2048 Hz. Eight additional external channels recorded electrocardiography (2 channels) and electrooculography (4 channels). Participants performed resource allocation decisions via mouse input over a 10-second response window, followed by a 5-second confidence rating phase using mouse wheel input.
